subject: TURKISH NAVY UNMANNED AIRCRAFT FLIGHT WILL TAKE PLACE WITHIN
text:
A3635/26 NOTAMN
Q) LGGG/QWULW/IV/BO /W /230/240/3517N02913E062
A) LGGG B) 2610112100 C) 2611112059
E) TURKISH NAVY UNMANNED AIRCRAFT FLIGHT WILL TAKE PLACE WITHIN
ATHINAI FIR AS DESCRIBED BELOW:
1.- AREA: 361230N 0284400E - 360000N 0291000E -
354300N 0291000E - 352100N 0300000E - 342726N 0295509E -
343232N 0285541E - 350500N 0280000E - 361230N 0284400E.
AWYS R19 AND M601 (LAKAD-EXELA), G18 AND L609 (NILAS-ALKIS), L995
(IRBAX-VANZA), N128 (OTHON-FOXLI), L52 (TIRMO-VAXOS), N134
(MASES-VANZA), L53 (ANIDE-MASES), N129 (TIRMO-KUMBI), R78 AND M978
(NIPIS-TOSKA), W54 AND Y661 (ORVIS-ANTAR) AFFECTED.
2.- PROCEDURES FOR UNMANNED AIRCRAFT:
2.1.- PRIOR ENTERING ATHINAI FIR, COORDINATION AND RADIO CONTACT
SHALL BE ESTABLISHED WITH THE COMPETENT ATHINAI FIR ATC UNIT,
ACCORDING TO ICAO ANNEX 2, APPENDIX 4, PARAS 1.3 AND 1.4 PROVISIONS
FOR THE UNMANNED ACFT FLIGHTS.
2.2.- UNMANNED AIRCRAFT SHALL NOT AFFECT HELLENIC NATIONAL AIRSPACE
LESS THAN 10NM ACCORDING TO AIP-GREECE, ENR 1.1-1, PARA 1.1.1.2.1.
2.3.- FLIGHT PLANS SHALL BE SUBMITTED ACCORDING TO ICAO ANNEX 2,
APPENDIX 4, PARA 1.6 AND ACCORDING TO AIP-GREECE, ENR 1.10 AND GEN
1.7-1.
F) 23000FT AMSL G) 24000FT AMSL
